meta.title: Accepting the same knockout offer twice is harmless
gaps: Open the vendor's pending knockout offer and accept it twice through double-click or retry; counter-offer acceptance is a different operation.
Verify exactly one knockout acceptance is recorded and the second attempt leaves the round and acceptance state unchanged.
Verify the repeated knockout acceptance produces no unpleasant UI error or HTTP 500 response.
